{{Quote|Orbital Security Station Six to Coruscant Control. Checking in. Nothing to see here but stars&hellip;|Femi|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref>}}
'''Femi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="comic" /> in the year [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline 1" /> She served aboard [[Orbital Security Station Six]], a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] monitoring the traffic in and out of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], just prior to an [[Sacking of Coruscant|attack]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. Femi was killed, along with her [[Femi's co-worker|co-worker]], in the first blast of the battle after an Imperial [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth Angral|Angral]] ordered his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] to fire on the station, starting the conflict.<ref name="comic" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Unidentified vessel, this is Coruscant Security. We weren't expecting&hellip; Do you have a ''clearance'' code?|Femi's communication to the Sith fleet|<ref name="The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant" />}}
Serving aboard [[Orbital Security Station Six]] over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the capital of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government, Femi, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived in the year [[3653 BBY]], worked with a [[Femi's co-worker|co-worker]] for [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security]] monitoring the traffic to and from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. She checked into [[Coruscant Control]], reporting that there was nothing in her vicinity, and shared a brief conversation with the dispatcher, saying that she was going planetside as her rotation aboard the satellite was complete. She then noticed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ships in her area and asked the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] for clearance codes.<ref name="comic" />

The [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and the Republic were meeting at [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to discuss terms for ending the [[Great Galactic War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict that had been taking place between them for decades, and the unexpected arrival of their fleet caught Femi off-guard. Rather than transmit a response back to her, Femi and her partner were killed after [[Darth Angral|Angral]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] from the Empire and leader of the assault, ordered his ship to fire on the satellite. This began the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire. The conflict ended with the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], an agreement that forced the Republic to abandon long-time allies and give many outlying worlds over to the Sith, putting an end to the Great Galactic War in favor of the Sith Empire.<ref name="comic" />

==Personality and traits==
Femi was a blue-skinned Twi'lek female with blue eyes. She worked for the Coruscant Security Force in a satellite orbiting the planet, regulating traffic arriving at or leaving the planet. She did not seem to take much pleasure in her job and was relieved when her shift was over so she could go planetside.<ref name="comic" />

==Equipment==
Femi and her co-worker wore a uniform with a black torso, white shoulder pads, and white sleeves. Their pants were also white. The headset that she wore on the job was a gold color.<ref name="comic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Femi was created for the first issue of the opening [[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant|arc]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] serving as a prequel to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|Massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] made by [[BioWare]].<ref name="comic" />
